title: A Domain Derivative for Electromagnetic Scattering by Perfect Conductors in the Time Domain
summary: A domain derivative for time-dependent electromagnetic scattering from perfect conductors is established. By proceeding through the Laplace domain, frequency-dependent bounds on solutions to Maxwell's equations are derived. These bounds are used both for establishing time regularity properties of the domain derivative and for proving convergence of the proposed Runge--Kutta convolution quadrature semi-discretization in time.
